#: Input-frames on the stand-in with scripts/input_toggle.json, --manifest tests/unit/data/manifest_toggle.json and --ini tests/conformance/ini/steamvr_evaluator.ini (inputEvaluator=steamvr). The toggle_button on the right trigger turns on at the first click (frame 10, a few frames later if loading the manifest restarted the session), off 20 frames later and on again 20 frames after that; bChanged only on those frames; active with an origin on every frame. The vector3 action reads (0.5, -0.25, 0) from the left thumbstick.
